relations.subject: Taklung Tsetrul Rinpoche
relations.evidence: He received the highest Dzogchen teachings from Polu Khenpo Dorje, a direct disciple of Khenpo Ngawang Pelzang.

relations.subject: Polu Khenpo Dorje
relations.evidence: Polu Khenpo Dorje, a direct disciple of Khenpo Ngawang Pelzang.

relations.subject: Taklung Tsetrul Rinpoche
relations.evidence: accepted the position of the Supreme Head of Nyingmapa lineage, the “Old Translation Tradition” in Tibetan Buddhism.

relations.subject: Taklung Tsetrul Rinpoche
relations.evidence: He is following Kyabje Dudjom Rinpoche, Kyabje Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche, Kyabje Drubwang Pema Norbu Rinpoche, Kyabje Mindroling Trichen Rinpoche, and then finally Kyabje Trulshik Rinpoche

relations.subject: Nawang Tashi Rapten
relations.evidence: The four-year-old Nawang Tashi Rapten from the Spiti Valley has, in November 2022, been placed on the high seat as the successor to Taklung Tsetrul Rinpoche.
